title: Q-FM-DISCOVER: register failure modes nobody wrote down, from the ledgers the loops already write
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:foundation/failure_audit.py::def discover
**Status:** closed

FAILURE-RESOLVE-1 audits every failure mode in `doctrine/registers.json`, but a failure that was never registered is still unseen. Add `discover(root)` to `foundation/failure_audit.py` and a `--discover [--apply]` flag: read `ops/executor-log.jsonl`, the open `Q-CIFAIL-*` items in `docs/issues/` and `docs/failures/`, group failures by signature (last line of the error, numbers removed), and for a signature seen three or more times that no detector's `root_cause` or failure mode's `trigger` mentions, append a failure mode `fm-discovered-<hash>` with status `open` to `doctrine/registers.json` and a command detector that reproduces the signature to `doctrine/detectors.json` (never a placeholder that always passes). Run it in `.github/workflows/failure-audit.yml` before `--run`. Add a test in `tests/foundation/test_failure_audit.py` that three rows with one signature register one mode and two rows register none.

Paths: `foundation/failure_audit.py`, `tests/foundation/test_failure_audit.py`, `doctrine/registers.json`, `doctrine/detectors.json`.

Prediction: discovered failure modes registered >= 1 within 168 h of merge.
